verdict.rationale: The evidence mentions general security/privacy features (private storage, a 'rules engine' for meeting access/privacy, a 0-day retention policy with third-party vendors/partners) but nothing documents an admin-facing retention-policy scheduler for auto-deleting transcripts/recordings, nor an on-demand permanent-erase capability for the org's own data. This is a fair and applicable axis for a meeting-recording SaaS handling sensitive transcripts, so absence of evidence yields none rather than na.
